mapProfile.thesis: Restore warning calls and skyline signals by mastering tempo and reading multi-part Tells.
bossPrepHints: Keep Open Sky Guard ready before the Beacon-Breaker's Molt-triggered calls.
Spend Wingbeat early to outrun stacking Winded Tells.
Sequence Plumes and Quills so a single big turn lands before the next telegraph resolves.

enemies.name: Signal Marshal
enemies.lesson: Elite: charges a beacon, then unloads a heavy strike.
enemies.description: A disciplined signal hawk that charges the spire beacons before diving through the flock's formation.
enemies.visualBrief: Lean raptor in a structured signal-marshal wind shell, narrow harness straps, talon bands, and beacon clips standing with antenna-cage signal styling.
enemies.silhouette: Tall angular officer shape with swept wings and a beacon-backed perch.

enemies.description: A fast relay starling that carries warning calls between antennas and leaves the flock winded in its wake.

signals.title: Dead Beacon
signals.prompt: A burned-out skyline beacon could be relit to mark the route, but climbing the spire leaves the flock exposed.

signals.title: Crossed Wires
signals.prompt: Tangled signal wires hum across the gap. Untangling them takes time, but a quiet landing could ease the next exposed crossing.

choices.text: Rig an Open Sky guard line.

signals.title: Warning Caller
signals.prompt: A lone caller still keeps the old warning songs. It will teach a sharper opening cry in exchange for help or supplies.

signals.title: Static Nest
signals.prompt: A nest wrapped in crackling static interference. Clearing it might restore a lost Waymark or scramble your deck.

signals.title: Fading Waymark
signals.prompt: A weathered sign flickers with the last traces of an old Waymark. You could preserve it, trade it for scrap, or let it fade and find your own path.

choices.text: Mark it with your own route.

signals.title: Wind Shear Passage
signals.prompt: Brutal wind shear cuts across the spire gap. Toughen the flock now, or accept the wind and land stronger afterward.

signals.title: Picker's Roost
signals.prompt: A roost full of shiny things: scrap, supplies, cards. You have time for one haul before the owner returns.

signals.title: Healer's Refuge
signals.prompt: An old healer still tends to injured birds in a sheltered tower alcove. Sanctuary, but at a cost.

choices.text: Learn her remedy — and her story.

signals.title: The Toll Gambit
signals.prompt: A figure at the tower crossing collects tolls — payment or peril. Most birds pay. Some don't make it across.
